caveats: Experimental beta for Paseo 0.13+ (tested on 0.14.0). Tool cards need the Full chat display; they do not join tool-call groups or fold turns.
Before using Collapse tool calls, Collapse turns or Summary, run "Activity: use native rows" on that client; the choice resets to cards on reload.
Do not enable alongside another tool-call or Thinking timeline replacement.
Show all and serialization can be expensive for very large payloads.
macOS host and web client tested on 0.14.0; desktop app and native iOS/Android untested.
